name: Negaeui Bit
source:
"My entire body broke out in goosebumps."
"The transcendent being who had planned for 6,000 years,
gazing at only one thing, declared the preparations complete."

"This story is of God and us and our grand revenge against Lucifer."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2708150/]Steam[/url]]
